title: The Same River, Twice
summary: First Anonymoses show and music by free improv ensemble
notes:
Anonymoses are a band playing new music.

James Wolfe - guitar, vocals
Vicente Reyes - synth, violin
Thomas Kerr - bass
Josh Dorrell - drums 

The Holy Child of Father Sun - free improv set by us joined by Cillian Bent and Phelim O'Laoghaire on drums and laptop. 

Jack Leitch did video design for both sets.
